messages:
incidents_bot: PAGER -> [SEV2] High 5xx spike on inference-gateway-us-east-1. 2.5k errors in last 5m, multiple model-runner pods restarted with OOM/KERNEL OOPS. Paging @shawn_oncall. https://redwood.incidents/3141592653 :rotating_light:
shawn_oncall: Acknowledged. I'm checking pod logs and dmesg now. grabbing top stacktraces. will follow runbook for runtime OOMs.
emma_dev: seeing repeated 'Killed process' OOM logs on model-runner-42 & -43, cgroup OOM score spikes. dmesg shows kernel oops at kv_cache.c:0x7f3a. No deploys in last 20m afaict but quant-kernel patch landed ~30m ago.
shawn_oncall: good catch. @emma_dev can you paste the tail of the runner logs? I'm attaching grep of oom messages.
emma_dev: ```
Jan 17 12:04:21 runner-42 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 31415 (model-runner) score 987 or sacrifice child
Jan 17 12:04:21 runner-42 model-runner[31415]: kv_cache_alloc: growth from 256MB -> 2.1GB in 30s
Jan 17 12:04:22 runner-42 model-runner[31415]: fatal: mmapped region fault (SIGSEGV)
```
shawn_oncall: Confirmed. Memory growth looks unbounded for some requests. I suspect the quantization kernel change increased KV cache retention pressure. Rolling back quant-kernel-opt on model-runner to previous image v1.3.3 -> v1.3.4 rollback.
nora_sre: I can start traffic fallback to us-west-2 standby to reduce blast radius. Recommend gradual ramp: 30% -> 100% over 3m while we roll back. /cc @customer_success for impact comms.
incidents_bot: ACTION -> routing policy change initiated: inference-gateway-us-east-1 -> us-west-2 : 30% at 12:10 UTC. Will auto ramp per policy. Customer impact: elevated 502/504 rates for ~12k requests.
customer_success: Noted. CS notified top impacted customers (fintech-co, docs.ai). They're asking for ETA.
matt_support: Any estimate on rollback completion? customers are asking for status updates. :alarm_clock:
shawn_oncall: Rollback started. Patching daemonset to image v1.3.3. Restarting pods sequentially with 30s drain. I'll monitor memory and 5xx.
emma_dev: temp mitigation: capping kv-cache to 1GB per model instance helps stop runaway growth. Command used: `REDWOOD_KV_CACHE_MAX=1073741824 systemctl restart model-runner`. Recommend adding as hotfix if rollback doesn't immediately help.
shawn_oncall: Implemented kv-cache cap on live pods, and rollback completed on all nodes at 12:16 UTC. Observed restart healthy. 5xx rate trending down from 4200rpm -> 180rpm.
nora_sre: I'm executing the full fallback to us-west-2 now to remove pressure on us-east-1. `redwood route set --service inference-gateway --from us-east-1 --to us-west-2 --weight 100`
incidents_bot: Fallback complete at 12:19 UTC. 5xx error rate dropped to baseline (~2%). Incident status -> mitigated. Pager cleared.
customer_success: Sending mitigation note to customers, offering follow-up postmortem.
matt_support: Thanks team. Please keep me posted if anything regresses.
shawn_oncall: Leaving monitors on for 30m. Handing off to @nora_sre for RCA and follow-up. I'll open a PR to revert the quant-kernel opt until we can validate memory behavior in staging. :memo:
nora_sre: Taking over. I'll gather logs, commit hashes, and timeline. @emma_dev please upload heap profiles and the failing prompt set so SRE/ML can reproduce.
incidents_bot: Incident archived to 'mitigated' at 12:22 UTC. Channel will auto-close in 30m unless new alerts occur
